title: The 1,000x AI Engineer: Swyx
talk_summary: This is a motivational keynote about the AI engineer role and macro trends (scaling laws, tech revolutions, career archetypes), not a technical talk. It contains no concrete engineering mechanisms, measurements, or system designs to copy.

takeaways.what_they_do: Frames leverage as knowledge propagation: an engineer who teaches 10 people multiplies output more than individual productivity hacks.
takeaways.evidence_quote: an engineer that teaches 10 other people what they know
